In seventeen oh-four, a Scottish sailor was left alone on an island, and ended up dancing with cats.
Alexander Selkirk told his captain the ship was going to sink.
The captain said: then stay here.
He was right. The ship sank. He was also alone.
At night, rats chewed his feet while he slept.
So he fed the wild cats goat meat. Then more cats. Soon, hundreds of them slept around him.
He tamed baby goats too. And to pass the time, he sang and danced with all of them.
Four years and four months later, a ship finally came. Selkirk outran their bulldog to catch them dinner.
But when he spoke, the sailors could barely understand him. He'd forgotten how to talk.
Cats keep away the rats. They don't keep away the silence.
If your days have gone quiet, talk to Jenny on Feeloy. She always talks back.
